name: wb-starter
description: Modern website starter kit powered by WB Behaviors

scripts.start: node scripts/pull-on-start.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.js --local && node scripts/update-docs-manifest.js && node server.js
scripts.test: npm run test:collection && npm run test:lock-guards && npm run test:summary-parse && npm run test:duplicates && npm run test:x-demo-integrity && npx playwright test --project=compliance && npx playwright test --project=regression && npx playwright test --project=integration && npx playwright test --project=base && npx playwright test --project=behaviors && npx playwright test --project=schema-viewer
scripts.test:compliance: npm run test:collection && npm run test:x-demo-integrity && npx playwright test --project=compliance
scripts.test:base: npx playwright test --project=compliance && npx playwright test --project=base
scripts.test:behaviors: npx playwright test --project=compliance && npx playwright test --project=base && npx playwright test --project=behaviors
scripts.test:all: npx playwright test --project=compliance && npx playwright test --project=regression && npx playwright test --project=integration && npx playwright test --project=base && npx playwright test --project=behaviors && npx playwright test --project=schema-viewer && npx playwright test --project=performance --workers=1
scripts.ci:docs-safety: npm run lint:md-powershell && npm run check:critical-scripts
scripts.precommit: npm run check:critical-scripts && npm run lint:md-powershell:staged

scripts-info.start: Run the site at localhost:3000: pulls main, stamps the version, rebuilds the docs list, then serves. Use this to work on or look at the site.
scripts-info.dev: Serve the folder as plain static files on :3000, with no build steps. Use to see what GitHub Pages would serve.
scripts-info.scripts:help: Print this list of scripts, grouped, with what each does and when to use it.
scripts-info.test:async: Run tests in the background and return at once: give a spec file, or a filter such as --project=regression. The way to test during the day; results land in data/test-single/ or data/test-status.json.
scripts-info.test:stop: Stop the background test run that test:async started.
scripts-info.test:ui: Open Playwright's interactive runner to watch, pick and debug tests by hand.
scripts-info.lint: Lint src, scripts and tests with ESLint. Use before you commit a larger change.
scripts-info.typecheck: Type-check the TypeScript test suite (report only). Use after editing tests.
scripts-info.test:regression: Run the regression tests: one test per fixed bug. Use after a fix, to see nothing came back.
scripts-info.test:integration: Run the integration tests: doc viewer, wizard and other end-to-end flows.
scripts-info.test:compliance: Run every compliance (standards) check. Long; use before a big merge.
scripts-info.test:compliance:css: Compliance subset: CSS and layout rules. Use after a stylesheet change.
scripts-info.test:compliance:docs: Compliance subset: markdown and doc format. Use after editing docs.
scripts-info.test:compliance:demos: Compliance subset: demo pages and their registry. Use after editing demos.
scripts-info.test:compliance:schema: Compliance subset: behavior schemas and registry integrity. Use after a schema change.
scripts-info.test:compliance:attributes: Compliance subset: attribute names and syntax. Use after adding or renaming an option.
scripts-info.test:compliance:paths: Compliance subset: no absolute or unsafe paths. Use after moving files or links.
scripts-info.test:compliance:structure: Compliance subset: HTML structure and runtime rules.
scripts-info.test:base: Run compliance, then the base tests.
scripts-info.test:behaviors: Run compliance, base, then every behavior test. Use after changing a behavior.
scripts-info.test:dev: Run the base and behavior tests only: a quick local check while developing behaviors.
scripts-info.test:fast: Run every test but stop at the first failure. Use to find the first thing broken, fast.
scripts-info.test:inc: Run only the tests related to the files you changed.
scripts-info.test:single: Run tests one at a time (one worker). Use to rule out tests interfering with each other.
scripts-info.test:performance: Run the performance tests (one worker, slow). Use after a change that could slow pages down.
scripts-info.test: Pre-checks (test collection, lock guards, tally parser, duplicates, x-demo integrity), then the whole test matrix. Long: the Nightly run does this, so you rarely need it.
scripts-info.test:all: Every Playwright project in turn. Very long; Nightly covers it.
scripts-info.test:browsers: Firefox, WebKit and mobile browsers. Use for a change that may behave differently outside Chrome.
scripts-info.test:webkit: The tests in WebKit (Safari's engine) only.
scripts-info.test:mobile: The tests in mobile Chrome and mobile Safari.
scripts-info.test:mobile-validation: Phone layout checks on a Pixel and an iPhone viewport. Use after a layout change.
scripts-info.ship: Put the merged work on the public site as a named release batch. Only when John asks for a release.
scripts-info.release: Move the version number and write what is new. Only when John asks for a release.
scripts-info.release:check: Dry run of release: shows what it would do and changes nothing. Safe any time.
scripts-info.test:smoke:deployed: Check the live site after a push to main: pages load, no errors. Use after a merge is deployed.
scripts-info.test:deployed: Tests that need the live site or GitHub (gh). Run by hand; never part of a gate.
scripts-info.generate:search: Rebuild the site search index (data/search.json). Use after adding, removing or renaming pages or docs.
scripts-info.generate:wb-tests: Generate starter tests for behaviors from their schemas.
scripts-info.audit:schema-tests: List behavior schemas that have no tests.
scripts-info.audit:page-fragments: Check that every page in pages/ still works when opened at its own URL.
scripts-info.audit:behavior-registry: Check that every behavior's schema, code, CSS and registry entry agree.
scripts-info.check:behavior-examples: Check that the Behaviors page examples in data/behavior-examples.json are up to date.
scripts-info.make-video: Turn a narration MP3 into a finished video in one step.
scripts-info.cleanup:artifacts: Delete leftover test output and temporary files.
scripts-info.prepare: Runs on npm install: points git at .husky/ so the repo's hooks run in every clone.
scripts-info.precommit: Old pre-commit entry: critical-scripts check plus staged markdown lint. The .husky hook is what runs now.
scripts-info.lint:staged: Commit hook: lint only staged files against the lint baseline.
scripts-info.lint:ratchet: CI: check the whole repo against the lint baseline.
scripts-info.lint:baseline: Re-measure and freeze the lint baseline. Only as a deliberate decision; it accepts today's warnings as normal.
scripts-info.lint:md-powershell: Lint markdown for PowerShell-unsafe command examples (part of ci:docs-safety).
scripts-info.lint:md-powershell:staged: The same markdown lint on staged files only (commit hook).
scripts-info.ci:docs-safety: CI: markdown lint plus the critical-scripts check.
scripts-info.check:critical-scripts: Check that the npm scripts other tools depend on still exist.
scripts-info.check:staged-integrity: Commit hook: check staged files for integrity problems.
scripts-info.check:spec-collection: Commit hook: fail on a spec file that collects no tests (a spec that never runs).
scripts-info.check:today-updated: CI: a PR that changes docs/ must mention them in docs/_today.
scripts-info.test:collection: Before a suite: fail if any Playwright project collects zero tests.
scripts-info.test:duplicates: Part of npm test: find duplicate content and assets in the repo.
scripts-info.test:x-demo-integrity: Part of npm test: find unbalanced or empty <div x-demo> tags in pages and demos.
scripts-info.pw:maybe: Run Playwright only if tests match the arguments (used by hooks).
scripts-info.start:mcp: Start this project's MCP server with the web server. Claude Desktop starts it from .mcp.json.
scripts-info.mcp:healthcheck: Probe that the MCP server is up (CI and orchestration).
scripts-info.test:lock-guards: Self-test: the machine-wide test locks (one suite at a time across worktrees).
scripts-info.test:gate-guards: Self-test: the commit gate finishes in bounded time and holds the machine lock.
scripts-info.test:playwright-launch: Self-test: a --grep pattern reaches Playwright as one argument.
scripts-info.test:ship-rollback: Self-test: a failed ship deletes only the tag it made.
scripts-info.test:staged-control-bytes: Self-test: the commit hook refuses files carrying stray control bytes.
scripts-info.test:body-file-handoff: Self-test: a commit or issue body file changed by another session is not used.
scripts-info.test:suite-env: Self-test: a test suite's scratch git commands cannot reach the real repo.
scripts-info.test:free-port: Self-test: every local test run gets its own port.
scripts-info.test:summary-parse: Self-test: the test-run tally counts each test once.
scripts-info.test:pages-deploy-state: Self-test: the deployed-smoke gate reads GitHub Pages deploy state correctly.

author: CieloVista Software
